newsitem.title: USA: Stocks fall as early rally gives way to profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Stocks fall as early rally gives way to profit-taking.

text.p: NEW YORK - Blue-chip stocks tumbled Tuesday as an early rally gave way to a steady stream of profit-taking.

The Dow Jones industrial average sank 74.91 points to 6,446.79 in late trading. The decline accelerated in late afternoon as computer-driven selling kicked in. But in the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a narrow 13-12 margin and the Nasdaq composite index, laden with technology stocks, moved higher.
